column1: # Ukrainian (uk). Claude-only proposal, drafted 2026-11-05, pending the three-vendor debate; not final. Wave 3 is the owner's "only if easy" group: report this setup to the owner before relying on it.

# percent_style and decimal_style use a no-break space (U+00A0), never U+202F. decimal_style is an example of the separators; four-digit numbers take no separator in text (1234,5). Saira has no Cyrillic, so font is system and fit is checked on a device.
